title: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang urges countries to build their own sovereign AI
summary:
Countries developing sovereign AI could reduce reliance on foreign tech, but still depend on Nvidia, highlighting complex tech sovereignty.
The post Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang urges countries to build their own sovereign AI appeared first on Crypto Briefing.
content: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang has encouraged countries to develop their own sovereign artificial intelligence. By building domestic AI infrastructure, nations can reduce their reliance on foreign technology. However, critics note that these countries will likely still depend heavily on Nvidia for the necessary hardware, highlighting the ongoing complexities surrounding global technological independence.
content_ta: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang நாடுகits சொந்த sovereign AI-ஐ உருவாக்க வேண்டும் என்று வலியுறுத்தியுள்ளார். உள்நாட்டு AI உள்கட்டமைப்பை உருவாக்குவதன் மூலம் வெளிநாட்டு தொழில்நுட்பத்தைச் சார்ந்திருப்பதை நாடுகள் குறைக்க முடியும். இருப்பினும், தேவையான வன்பொருளுக்காக இந்த நாடுகள் தொடர்ந்து Nvidia-ஐச் சார்ந்திருக்க வேண்டியிருக்கும் என்பதை இது காட்டுகிறது.

title: Google’s Gemini 4 Argon processes nearly 25 trillion tokens in its first 72 hours
summary:
Google's Gemini 4 Argon's rapid adoption highlights potential scalability challenges, impacting Google's ability to meet growing AI demand.
The post Google’s Gemini 4 Argon processes nearly 25 trillion tokens in its first 72 hours appeared first on Crypto Briefing.
content: Google’s Gemini 4 Argon has processed nearly 25 trillion tokens within its first 72 hours of launch. This rapid adoption showcases massive user interest while also highlighting potential scalability challenges for Google as the company works to meet the continuously growing global demand for advanced artificial intelligence services.
content_ta: Google-ன் Gemini 4 Argon தனது வெளியீட்டின் முதல் 72 மணி நேரத்திற்குள் கிட்டத்தட்ட 25 டிரில்லியன் டோக்கன்களை செயலாக்கியுள்ளது. இந்த விரைவான பயன்பாடு மிகப்பெரிய பயனர்களின் ஆர்வத்தைக் காட்டுவதுடன், வளர்ந்து வரும் AI தேவையைப் பூர்த்தி செய்ய Google எதிர்கொள்ளக்கூடிய அளவிடுதல் சவால்களையும் வெளிச்சம் போட்டுக் காட்டுகிறது.

title: Illinois Laboratory Owner Charged in $66,000,000 COVID-19 Testing Fraud Scheme, Faces Decades Behind Bars
summary:
Federal prosecutors have charged an Illinois laboratory owner with running a large-scale scheme to submit claims for COVID-19 tests that were never performed. Rajesh “Raj” Patel, 52, of Schaumburg, faces five counts of wire fraud after the laboratory allegedly billed the U.S. Health Resources and Services Administration (HRSA) Uninsured Program for at least 380,000 nonexistent […]
The post Illinois Laboratory Owner Charged in $66,000,000 COVID-19 Testing Fraud Scheme, Faces Decades Behind Bars appeared first on The Daily Hodl.
tags: U.S. Health Resources and Services Administration
content: An Illinois laboratory owner has been charged by federal prosecutors in a massive COVID-19 testing fraud scheme. Rajesh “Raj” Patel, 52, allegedly billed the U.S. Health Resources and Services Administration for tens of millions of dollars covering hundreds of thousands of nonexistent tests. Patel now faces multiple counts of wire fraud and decades in prison if convicted.
content_ta: Illinois-ஐ சேர்ந்த லேப் ஒன்றின் உரிமையாளர் மீது கோடிக்கணக்கான டாலர் மதிப்பிலான COVID-19 பரிசோதனை மோசடி வழக்கில் மத்திய அரசு வழக்குப்பதிவு செய்துள்ளது. Schaumburg-ஐ சேர்ந்த Rajesh “Raj” Patel, எந்தவித பரிசோதனைகளும் செய்யாமல் U.S. Health Resources and Services Administration அமைப்புக்கு போலியான பில்களை சமர்ப்பித்ததாக குற்றம் சாட்டப்பட்டுள்ளது. இதன் மூலம் அவர் பல ஆண்டுகள் சிறைத்தண்டனையை எதிர்கொள்ள நேரிடும்.

title: Moneyhub and Know Your Dosh Bring Open Banking to Family Financial Planning
summary:
Moneyhub, the leading Applied AI and data intelligence platform for financial institutions, today announced that Know Your Dosh, a UK family financial management app, has selected its technology. The partnership will let Know Your Dosh users automatically sync accounts across a household, including current accounts, savings, investments and pensions. This gives families a single, shared view of their finances without the friction of manual updates or the risk of sharing login credentials. Once connected, a full insights suite is unlocked, including a feature that details a families’ true household budget. 
Know Your Dosh is built around a simple truth.  Financial transparency within a family is rare, financial admin is a headache, and money conversations can feel even harder.  It is designed for households managing shared financial lives across different accounts, life stages, and generations, and since going live with Moneyhub tracks more than £200 million in assets through its dashboard. Until now, keeping track of those assets has required manual input. A barrier that stops many families from engaging with their finances altogether.  
By integrating Moneyhub's FCA-regulated infrastructure, Know Your Dosh removes that barrier entirely. Accounts update automatically through direct, secure connections. No manual reconciliation is required. Families can instead focus on  what they have, what they owe, and what they are planning for. 
The platform allows users to set granular controls over what each family member can see, so a household can share a consolidated financial picture without every individual having full visibility of every account. A partner can track joint finances without accessing the other's personal savings, or a parent can oversee household budgets without a teenager seeing the full picture. 
The partnership arrives at a moment of growing urgency around household financial visibility, with the total value of dormant and forgotten assets held by UK families estimated to be at £89 billion. Moneyhub's data aggregation capability is designed to address precisely this problem, ensuring nothing important gets lost, and no account falls silently out of sight. 
Dan Scholey, CPO at Moneyhub, said: "Most fintech is built for the individual, but with modern, secure data sharing we can unlock those relationships that matter. The team at Know Your Dosh have built something that meets families where they actually are. Moneyhub’s job is to make sure the data behind it is as complete and as accurate as possible.”    
Varun Aggarwal, Founder and CEO at Know Your Dosh, said: "When I lost my father, the financial chaos that followed wasn’t because my family was careless, but because no one had ever created a space for us to understand our money together. That experience is why Know Your Dosh exists. We built it for every family that avoids the money conversation because it feels too complicated to start. Partnering with Moneyhub means our users no longer have to do the hard work of keeping their finances up to date. It happens automatically, securely, and in the background. And crucially, every family member sees exactly what they need to see, and nothing they don’t. The UK has the infrastructure to make this work at scale, and we’re excited to build here first.” 
NoYesBanking21 Oct, 2026
content: Moneyhub has partnered with Know Your Dosh to bring open banking technology to family financial planning in the UK. The collaboration allows users to automatically sync household accounts, including savings, investments, and pensions, providing a single shared view of family finances. The platform integrates Moneyhub's regulated infrastructure to streamline budgeting and secure asset tracking, helping families manage shared financial lives without manual updates.
content_ta: UK-ல் குடும்ப நிதி திட்டமிடலுக்கு Open Banking தொழில்நுட்பத்தை கொண்டு வர Moneyhub நிறுவனம் Know Your Dosh உடன் கூட்டு சேர்ந்துள்ளது. இந்த ஒத்துழைப்பு பயனர்கள் சேமிப்புகள், முதலீடுகள் மற்றும் ஓய்வூதியங்கள் உள்ளிட்ட குடும்பக் கணக்குகளை தானாகவே ஒத்திசைக்க அனுமதிக்கிறது, இது குடும்ப நிதிகளின் ஒட்டுமொத்த பார்வையை வழங்குகிறது. இந்த தளம் பட்ஜெட்டை மேம்படுத்தவும் பாதுகாப்பான சொத்து கண்காணிப்புக்காகவும் Moneyhub இன் ஒழுங்குபடுத்தப்பட்ட உள்கட்டமைப்பை ஒருங்கிணைக்கிறது.
